theme_strategy: Hybrid Theme (Dark/Cinematic for Marketing, Light/Clean for Admin Dashboard)

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#D4AF37]

rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for all marketing headings to provide a cinematic, elegant, and cultural feel.
Use Manrope for body text and Admin Dashboard interfaces for extreme legibility.
Support bilingual rendering by gracefully falling back to Noto Serif SC/Noto Sans SC.

textures: Subtle paper/plaster texture overlay: use a fixed background div with mix-blend-multiply or opacity-5 over maroon/beige backgrounds to simulate traditional drum skins and brush stroke canvas.
shadows: Marketing: Ambient, diffused shadows with #410C09 tinted glow.
Dashboard: Crisp, structural shadows (e.g., shadow-sm, shadow-md) with #000000/5.
glassmorphism: Navbar: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#410C09]/80 on dark sections, or bg-[#F5F1E7]/80 on light sections. Include a 1px border-white/10 to define the edge.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: py-20 to py-32 for marketing sections.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For 'Achievements' and 'Packages', use an asymmetrical grid (e.g., span-2 for featured package, span-1 for standard) to create visual tension.
grids_and_layouts.timeline: Vertical staggered layout. Alternating left and right content blocks on desktop, single column on mobile.
grids_and_layouts.gallery: Masonry grid or tight asymmetric grid for performance imagery.

components.hero: Cinematic full-height (100vh) hero. Background image/video with a bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#410C09]/50 to-transparent overlay. Large centered text.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar. Z-index 50. Must include language switcher (EN/中文).
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black rounded-sm hover:bg-white transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 rounded-sm.
components.performance_packages: 3-tier pricing cards. Center/Featured card visually pops using a dark maroon background, while side cards use warm beige.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized (border-b only inputs, minimalist). Include WhatsApp API redirect link on submission if required.

motion.reveals: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveals (y: 40, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, duration 0.8s, ease: custom bezier).
motion.hover_states: Images in gallery should scale slightly (scale-105) on hover within an overflow-hidden container.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'framer-motion' for complex animations and scroll reveals.
Ensure complete bilingual support structure (i18n ready) or build a simple context-based language toggler for EN/ZH.
Build standard marketing sections: Hero, About, History (Timeline), Gallery, Packages, Contact.
Build a separate /admin route featuring a standard dashboard layout (Sidebar + Content) with light theme (#FAFAFA background).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout blocks; reserve Shadcn strictly for interactive elements like Forms, Modals, Tabs, Dropdowns.
For the cultural aesthetic, avoid generic flat colors. Use the provided texture overlay image with low opacity over the maroon background to give it a 'drum skin' or 'canvas' feel.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break patterns: use asymmetric grids, extreme typography scaling, and textured backgrounds.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; always use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent fill.
DO NOT center-align paragraph text globally.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='lang-switcher-btn').
Ensure text contrast ratios meet APCA standards. Light text on the dark maroon is required.
Create a cohesive experience with micro-interactions on all clickable elements.
